description: dep.scale parameter changes from i32 to i64 while app passes a typed i32 binding; expect E_TYPE_MISMATCH and no executable.

expected_invalidation.note: Public signature changes. dep itself remains valid, but app call with i32 must fail type checking; an old successful executable must not be served.

measurement_note: expected_invalidation is a design expectation only; this reference run measures language result, not cache hits.
